From: Gita Sharma <gita@medihub.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 08:14:00 -0800
Subject: Temporary evidence hold for upcoming backup purge

Hi Soojin,

We discovered a late-stage regulatory review at MediHub that requires us to preserve a narrow slice of customer telemetry and inference logs tied to 6 customer IDs. Our scheduled backup purge (full retention sweep) is currently planned for Nov 20. Can Redwood place a temporary evidence hold on the affected snapshots and logs for 30 days while we complete the audit?

Specifically we need:
- A 30-day temporary hold on purge for the listed object keys / snapshots
- A one-time export of server-side request logs (timestamped) for the affected keys
- Confirmation of exact purge window once the hold is lifted

I attached a short inventory (medi_req_inventory.xlsx) that lists the object keys and timeframe. We understand there are DPA constraints and are prepared to sign any short addendum needed. Please let us know what you need on our side (manifest, POA, signed addendum) and an internal contact at Redwood to coordinate.

Thanks,
Gita Sharma
Compliance Lead, MediHub
[Attachment: medi_req_inventory.xlsx (xlsx)]

Thanks Gita — I see the inventory. I'm escalating to Legal and Ops so we can confirm scope and timeline. A few quick Qs to help us scope the ask:

1) Are the listed object keys tied to active customer accounts or are they historical snapshots?
2) Do you need the full raw request payloads or just metadata + timestamps?
3) Is 30 days the firm window or would MediHub accept a 21-day emergency hold with an extension option?

Per process, we generally require a short written addendum to the DPA for customer-requested preserves that extend beyond automated retention windows. @kimberly, can you confirm the legal checklist and whether SOC2 evidence from our side will be needed up-front? @karthik, can you estimate whether we can isolate and mark the listed snapshots as \"temp-hold\" without impacting the regular purge churn?

Gita — if you can confirm answers to (1)-(3) we can turn around a proposed addendum + operational plan.

Best,
Soojin Lee

Hi all — short legal note and required intake items so we can move quickly. Under our standard DPA, customers can request short-term preservation for investigatory/audit reasons, but we need a signed addendum that: (a) identifies the exact object keys (CSV manifest), (b) states a business justification and POA for the preservation, and (c) specifies the requested duration.

To speed this up I attached a recent SOC2 snapshot that demonstrates our control environment. Once Gita provides the CSV manifest and a short justification email, we will:
- Draft a one-page DPA addendum (DocuSign-ready) for MediHub to sign.
- Ops will apply a temporary hold tag (\"temp-hold-mh-202611\") scoped to the manifest once Legal acknowledges receipt of the signed addendum.

Note on cost: if the preservation requires ongoing storage beyond our normal retention policy (i.e., extended beyond 30 days), we will include a pass-through charge to cover storage and export costs. We'll call that out in the addendum.

Attachment: SOC2-snapshot.pdf (control summary)

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Gita — thanks for the quick reply earlier and for the inventory. Confirming next steps and internal owners so nothing slips between now and the Nov 20 purge: 

- MediHub to provide: CSV manifest (object_key, customer_id, earliest_timestamp, latest_timestamp) + one-paragraph justification email to legal (requested by end of day 11/19).
- Legal (Kimberly) will: prepare one-page DPA addendum and send DocuSign link. Expect ~4 business hours turnaround after we receive the manifest.
- Ops (Karthik) will: apply a \"temp-hold-mh-202611\" tag to the listed snapshots and prepare a one-time log export (gzipped) scoped to the manifest once addendum is signed. Ops will also add a calendar entry to prevent automated purge jobs for those keys during the hold.
- Growth/Account (Marissa) will: log this as an active deal task in HubSpot and track completion.

Tentative timeline: sign addendum by 11/19 EOD -> Ops applies hold and confirms by 11/20 11:59 AM PST -> we will then hold for the requested 30 days unless MediHub requests early release.

Attachments referenced: medi_req_inventory.xlsx (from MediHub) — please attach the CSV manifest version when you send the justification.

Related links: DocuSign (https://app.docusign.com/12345-addendum-MediHub), HubSpot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/deal/HL-5871)

If that works, Kimberly will circulate the DocuSign and Karthik will provision the hold when legal confirms execution.

Best,
